detailed_findings.description: Environment schema contains optional browser-visible development token declaration.
detailed_findings.remediation: PROT-F02 Action: Explicitly excluded and disallowed in production Next.js standalone demo builds. Replaced with server-issued evaluation tokens via X-Evaluation-License header.
